clue.text: Thai cycling around a Greek island

indicators.note: cycling sends the letters of the word Thai round in a loop, the last one coming to the front

parts.note: ca (circa) is the abbreviation for around, used with dates

explanation.surface: A Thai tourist pedals round a Greek island on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycling' looks like riding a bike; here it moves the last letter of the word to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Odysseus's home in the Ionian Sea is one of the islands of Greece.

clue.text: Supportive colleague with Dutch banker

parts.note: ING is a Dutch bank, so someone working there is an ING man

explanation.surface: A helpful workmate is teamed up with a banker from the Netherlands.
explanation.walkthrough: ING is a large Dutch banking group; its employee is read as an ING MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A wingman is a friend or associate who backs you up, especially on a night out.

clue.text: Batters patient person in crime involving employee

parts.note: in cricket the batting team is the side that is in, so batters are the in side
Job of the Bible is proverbial for patience

explanation.surface: A cricketer bashes someone long-suffering, in some criminal scenario.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Batters' looks like a verb of violence; it is the cricketing team currently batting, the side that is in.
explanation.definitionFit: A theft or fraud carried out by someone working for the victim organisation is an inside job.

clue.text: Guitarist/piss …

definitions.meaning: The guitarist of the rock band Guns N' Roses
British slang: to have a ... is to urinate

explanation.walkthrough: The oblique stroke printed between the two words is itself a slash, making a third definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The stage name of a rock musician, a slang word for urinating, and the punctuation mark '/'.

clue.text: … artist: "Don't share energy-starved planet"

parts.note: to hog something is to keep it to yourself rather than share it

indicators.note: starved of energy means the E (physics symbol for energy) is removed

parts.note: the planet we live on is Earth

explanation.surface: A painter's message: stop hogging a world short of power.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to 4, but the clues are separate; 'energy-starved' drops E from EARTH to leave ARTH.
explanation.definitionFit: William Hogarth was an eighteenth-century English painter and engraver of satirical scenes.

clue.text: Books a girl to open in American Tales

indicators.note: the pair of pieces breaks open the American abbreviation and sits inside it

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible
Ruth is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl is booked to launch some American storybooks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tales' is the definition in the sense of lies, not stories.
explanation.definitionFit: Telling tales can mean telling lies, so tales here are falsehoods.

clue.text: Sailor not dancing but twisting

indicators.note: dancing letters jump about into a new order

explanation.surface: A sailor declines to dance but does the twist instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' rearranges SAILOR NOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Torsional describes the stress or motion of a body being twisted.

clue.text: Prince among artists

definitions.meaning: an Ethiopian title for a prince or chief
Royal Academicians, members of the Royal Academy of Arts

explanation.walkthrough: With the puzzle a tribute to the singer Prince, the solver expects him; 'among' only links the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ethiopian princely title, and the plural of RA, a member of London's Royal Academy of painters.

clue.text: Publication such as Skin

definitions.meaning: a newspaper or magazine that speaks for a body is its ...
the skin is the body's largest ...

explanation.definitionFit: A party mouthpiece journal and a part of the body like the skin both share this word.

clue.text: Tate and Saatchi for example have many followers of course

definitions.meaning: the Tate and the Saatchi are London art museums
at golf the spectators trailing the players round the course are the gallery

explanation.surface: Famous art houses attract lots of fans, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' looks like 'naturally'; it means on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhibition spaces for art, and crowds of golf spectators, are both called by this word.

clue.text: Spear for example found in Brazilian tree

indicators.note: found in places the short piece inside the tree's name

parts.note: the assai is a Brazilian palm, source of acai berries
eg abbreviates exempli gratia, for example

explanation.surface: An example of a spear is discovered lodged in a Brazilian tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The assegai is a slender iron-tipped throwing weapon of southern Africa.

clue.text: Plaster produced after accident with this in office

indicators.note: the letters come out jumbled, as if by an accident

explanation.surface: An office injury from this gadget needs a plaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produced after accident' rearranges PLASTER; the whole clue also describes stapling a finger, so it is nearly an all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: A desk device fixing papers together is found in every office.

clue.text: Norwegian band covering record by live act finally leading to letters

indicators.note: covering means the band's name wraps round the record

parts.note: a-ha is the Norwegian pop group of Take On Me
LP is a long-playing record
to live is to be

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A Norwegian pop group covers a record by a live act, leading to fan mail.
explanation.walkthrough: With 15 it forms ALPHABET STREET, a Prince single.
explanation.definitionFit: The full set of letters used to write a language, A to Z.

clue.text: Flowers originally planted on border grew slowly at first

indicators.note: on places the planted letter in front of the edge, as in a down light one piece sits on top of the next
originally takes the opening letter of the word after it

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border
rose means grew or increased

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: Flowers set on a border were slow to come up at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Primroses are pale yellow spring flowers of the genus Primula.

clue.text: Way Oscar-winning actress steered clear of Last Tango

indicators.note: steering clear of the last letter means it is left out

parts.note: Meryl Streep has won three Oscars
T is Tango in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A film star avoids appearing in Last Tango in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last Tango' looks like the film; 'Last' joins the deletion and 'Tango' gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: A road in a town, which is one kind of way.

clue.text: Recurring theme of freshening up toilet with vim

indicators.note: freshening up the letters mixes them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Cleaning the loo with Vim, a scouring powder, is a running theme.
explanation.walkthrough: Vim is a British brand of scouring cleaner; 'freshening up' rearranges TOILET and VIM.
explanation.definitionFit: A leitmotiv is a musical or literary motif that returns repeatedly, as in Wagner.

clue.text: Drops Middle Eastern country heading to the right

indicators.note: the leading letter shifts to the right, further along the word

parts.note: Iran is a country in the Middle East

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern country turns to the political right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading to the right' moves the first letter, I, one place along.
explanation.definitionFit: Rain falls as drops of water from clouds.

clue.text: A rolled-up piece of paper in spliff leading to censure

indicators.note: rolled up in a down light means the short word is turned over, read bottom to top

parts.note: a, as in five pounds a head, means per
the roach is the rolled card filter at the end of a joint

explanation.surface: A rolled cigarette paper in a joint leads to a telling-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A' gives PER (as in 'a head'), which 'rolled-up' turns to REP.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproach someone is to rebuke or express disapproval of them.

clue.text: Romeo's remaining, figuratively

indicators.note: figuratively asks for the left in the phrase to be written as its symbol, a single letter

parts.note: remaining means left over

explanation.surface: Romeo is what is left, in a manner of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'figuratively' tells the solver to write LEFT as its abbreviation L in LEFT OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Romeo is the archetype of a romantic suitor.

clue.text: X rated Prince single

definitions.meaning: a cross at the end of a letter stands for a smooch

explanation.surface: An X-rated record released by Prince.
explanation.walkthrough: 'X rated' reads as one phrase; X is the definition and 'rated' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: The X signed at the foot of a message and the 1986 Prince single share this word.

clue.text: Spanish bigwig called a bastard

indicators.note: bastard as an adjective means corrupt or debased, so the letters are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: A Spanish grandee is insulted with a coarse name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bastard' rearranges CALLED A.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcalde is the mayor or magistrate of a Spanish town.

clue.text: Struggle when genoa is fluttering

indicators.note: fluttering in the wind tosses the letters about

explanation.surface: Sailors struggle when the genoa, a large foresail, flaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fluttering' rearranges GENOA IS.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to struggle anxiously over a decision.

clue.text: Hue and cry about 'posh' way of speaking

indicators.note: about means the whining word goes round the other piece

parts.note: to pule is to whimper or cry feebly
RP is Received Pronunciation, the prestige British accent

explanation.surface: A hue and cry about the way upper-class people talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hue and cry' is a stock phrase; 'Hue' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Purple is a colour between red and blue.

clue.text: Men only heading exciting group of games for props etc

parts.note: a stag party is for men only

indicators.note: heading takes the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: a set in tennis is a group of games

explanation.surface: A men-only event leads an exciting tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: The scenery and props on a theatre's boards make up its stage set.

clue.text: French you study from somewhere in Italy

parts.note: tu is French for you, familiar form
to scan is to study closely

explanation.surface: A French student studying from an Italian town.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuscan means from Tuscany, the region round Florence.

clue.text: Alice somehow captured through the looking glass in this?

definitions.text: captured through the looking glass in this?

indicators.note: somehow says the name is reworked by some unspecified means

explanation.surface: Alice, seen through the looking glass, as in Carroll's book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges ALICE; the looking glass is a camera lens, not Carroll's mirror.
explanation.definitionFit: Leica is a German brand of camera, which records images through a lens.

clue.text: Ready to be transported where Prince was in his element

definitions.meaning: sitting on a stagecoach you are ready to travel

definitions.text: where Prince was in his element
definitions.meaning: the singer Prince was at his best performing live in front of an audience

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: on a stage, meaning a stagecoach.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer at a concert is in front of the audience on the boards, and a coach passenger is aboard the coach.

clue.text: Literary collection to put on page in a short time when sent back

indicators.note: sending back means everything before it is read in reverse

parts.note: to sub is to subedit copy for the printed page
taken as written
mo is short for a moment

explanation.surface: Getting a literary anthology into print quickly, then returning it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when sent back' reverses SUB IN MO.
explanation.definitionFit: An omnibus edition gathers several works by one author in a single volume.

clue.text: Rival airline carrying Ryanair's first supporter

indicators.note: carrying means the airline holds the letter within it

parts.note: BA is British Airways, a rival of Ryanair

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of the airline's name

explanation.surface: One airline flies another's first passenger.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra is an undergarment that supports the bust.

clue.text: Boxed with scoundrel going around the London area

indicators.note: going around means the rogue encloses the other piece

parts.note: a cad is a dishonourable man
SE is the South East, the region round London

explanation.surface: A boxer and a rogue tour the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cased is enclosed in a box or container.

clue.text: Energy when Manchester United player produces crosses

parts.note: chi is the life force in Chinese thought
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
Juan Mata played for Manchester United

explanation.surface: A footballer's display of energy produces crosses into the box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crosses' suggests football; it is the biological sense.
explanation.definitionFit: In genetics, chiasmata are the X-shaped points where chromosomes swap material during meiosis.
